signal.headline: Supplier B's next delivery is likely to arrive after stock runs out

evidence.text: Last four deliveries arrived 3 to 6 days late
Current stock covers about 5 days at this week's sales rate
Delays this long usually repeat for a few weeks

ask.question: Is there a backup supplier you could use this week?

options.label: Reorder from backup
options.rationale: Covers the gap if B is late again

options.label: Chase Supplier B
options.rationale: Cheaper if B can confirm a date

check_in.question: Did you run out of stock before the next delivery?
